description: Main frontend source file for a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe game. It defines the main app widget, home page with game state management, and UI layout for the game board, reset button, and player indicators.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Tic Tac Toe application, sets up MaterialApp with theme and home page.

classes.name: TicTacToeHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the home page with game UI and state management.

classes.name: _TicTacToeHomePageState
classes.description: State class for TicTacToeHomePage managing game logic, board state, and UI rebuilds.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state, clearing the board and resetting current player and game over status.

methods.name: handleCellTap
methods.description: Handles a tap on a cell; updates the board, checks for win or draw, and switches player.

methods.name: _checkWinner
methods.description: Checks all winning patterns to determine if a player has won.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI layout of the home page including the game board, player indicator, and reset button.
